entries.zh: 此外、另外（书面与汇报常用）

examples.en: In addition to the new dashboard, we also rebuilt the alerting rules.
examples.zh: 除了新仪表盘，我们还重做了告警规则。

situation.zh: 你在方案里补充一条。
situation.en: In addition, the plan includes a load test before launch.

entries.note: in addition to + 名词/动名词；句首 In addition, 是“此外”。

examples.en: I reviewed his design, and in return he covered my on-call weekend.
examples.zh: 我帮他评审了设计，作为回报他替了我的周末值班。

situation.zh: 你开玩笑地向同事讨一杯咖啡当回报。
situation.en: Happy to help — in return, just owe me a coffee.

entries.zh: 正在筹备/开发中（还没完成）

examples.en: A proper fix is in the works, but it will not land this quarter.
examples.zh: 正经的修复正在做，但这个季度上不了。

situation.zh: 你向新人透露新流程正在开发中。
situation.en: There's a new onboarding flow in the works.

examples.en: With two kids and a release, I am on the go from six in the morning.
examples.zh: 两个孩子加上要发布，我从早上六点就连轴转。

situation.zh: 你提醒同事今天会很赶，咖啡带着走。
situation.en: Grab a coffee to go — we're on the go today.

examples.en: The house has been on the market for three months with no offers.
examples.zh: 这房子挂牌三个月了，没人出价。

situation.zh: 你介绍一款刚上市的产品。
situation.en: Their app just came on the market last month.

examples.en: Our team is always on the move during conference season.
examples.zh: 会议季我们团队一直在各地跑。

situation.zh: 闲聊出差多：每个月换一座城市。
situation.en: The roadmap keeps us on the move — new city every month.

examples.en: I wrote most of the talk on the road, in trains and airports.
examples.zh: 这次分享的大部分内容是我在路上写的，火车上和机场里。

situation.zh: 你同步下周在外出差、基本离线。
situation.en: I'll be on the road next week, mostly offline.

examples.en: The old service is on the verge of collapse under the new traffic.
examples.zh: 老服务在新流量下快要撑不住了。

situation.zh: 你说签约就差临门一脚时法务插进来了。
situation.en: We were on the verge of signing when their legal stepped in.

examples.en: I am on vacation next week — no laptop, no Slack.
examples.zh: 我下周休假，不带电脑、不看 Slack。

situation.zh: 你问同事休假期间谁顶他的服务。
situation.en: While you're on vacation, who covers your services?

entries.zh: 喘不上气、上气不接下气

examples.en: After the stairs to the fifth floor, I was completely out of breath.
examples.zh: 爬楼梯到五楼后，我喘得不行了。

situation.zh: 你跑着赶来开会，先喘口气。
situation.en: Give me a second — I'm out of breath from running here.

examples.en: The comment thread got out of hand, so a moderator locked it.
examples.zh: 评论串吵失控了，版主就把它锁了。

situation.zh: 你警告这个项目的需求膨胀失控了。
situation.en: Scope creep is getting out of hand on this project.

examples.en: The last spare server just died — we are out of luck this week.
examples.zh: 最后一台备用机刚坏，这周我们运气真是差透了。

situation.zh: 你告诉同事早鸟票没了，运气不好。
situation.en: You're out of luck — the early-bird tickets sold out yesterday.

entries.zh: 不在办公室（外出自动回复）

examples.en: Her out of office message says she returns on the fifth.
examples.zh: 她的外出自动回复说她五号回来。

situation.zh: 你说今晚走之前会设好自动回复。
situation.en: I'll set my out of office before I leave tonight.

entries.note: out of office 常缩写 OOO：I'm OOO Friday. 我周五不在。

examples.en: A gaming keyboard looks out of place in a bank's office.
examples.zh: 游戏键盘放在银行的办公室里显得格格不入。

situation.zh: 你评价文档里有一段放错了位置。
situation.en: That paragraph feels out of place in the summary.

examples.en: The fix is simple; the legacy data is just out of reach behind a VPN.
examples.zh: 修复很简单，只是遗留数据在 VPN 后面够不着。

situation.zh: 你提醒大家零食别让办公室的狗够着。
situation.en: Keep the snacks out of reach of the office dog.

examples.en: Half the team is still on the fence about the rewrite.
examples.zh: 团队有一半人对重写还持观望态度。

situation.zh: 你告诉同事你还没拿定主意。
situation.en: I'm still on the fence — convince me on Friday.

examples.en: There is a lot at stake in this launch — the renewal depends on it.
examples.zh: 这次上线利害很大，续约就指着它了。

situation.zh: 你劝大家这件事利害太大、不能草率定。
situation.en: Too much is at stake to rush this decision.

entries.note: at stake 的 stake 是赌注；high stakes 指高风险高回报的局面。

examples.en: His roadmap is at odds with what the data team needs.
examples.zh: 他的路线图和数据组的需求相冲突。

situation.zh: 你指出两份报告的结论互相矛盾。
situation.en: The two reports are at odds with each other.

examples.en: The load test picks users at random, not in sign-up order.
examples.zh: 压测是随机挑用户，不是按注册顺序。

situation.zh: 你提议随机抽几张工单看看质量。
situation.en: Let's sample a few tickets at random and read them.

examples.en: They asked for a demo at short notice, so we reused last month's slides.
examples.zh: 他们临时通知要演示，我们就用了上个月的幻灯片。

situation.zh: 你为临时改时间向对方道歉。
situation.en: Sorry for the short notice — can we move it to three?

examples.en: At the moment, the fix is only in staging, not production.
examples.zh: 目前这个修复只在预发，还没上生产。

situation.zh: 你表示当下实在接不了新项目。
situation.en: I can't take another project at the moment.

examples.en: At times, the simplest explanation is just a typo in the config.
examples.zh: 有时候，最简单的解释就是配置里有个错别字。

situation.zh: 闲聊时你感慨偶尔会怀念小团队时期。
situation.en: At times I miss the small-team days.

examples.en: The alert fired and half the team replied at once.
examples.zh: 告警一响，半个团队同时回复了。

situation.zh: 你提醒别同时上两个改动。
situation.en: Don't deploy both changes at once — we won't know which broke it.

entries.note: at once 还表“马上”：Come here at once! 靠语境区分。

examples.en: By and large, the migration went smoothly.
examples.zh: 总的来说，这次迁移很顺利。

situation.zh: 闲聊远程办公：总的来说挺适合我。
situation.en: By and large, working from home suits me.

entries.zh: 迄今为止最……、远远地（和最高级连用）

examples.en: This is by far the most useful internal tool we have.
examples.zh: 这是我们迄今为止最有用的内部工具，没有之一。

situation.zh: 你说这次是今年最顺的一次发布。
situation.en: That was by far the smoothest launch this year.

entries.zh: 换换口味、难得地（做点不一样的）

examples.en: Let's skip the usual dashboard and review raw logs for a change.
examples.zh: 我们换换口味，别看平时的仪表盘了，直接看原始日志。

situation.zh: 你提议午饭换个地方吃。
situation.en: Let's eat somewhere new for a change.

examples.en: We take the build pipeline for granted until the day it breaks.
examples.zh: 我们平时把构建流水线当成理所当然，直到它坏的那天。

situation.zh: 你提醒大家别把支持团队的付出当理所当然。
situation.en: Don't take the support team for granted.

entries.note: for granted 也可以形容人被忽视：feel taken for granted 觉得付出没人珍惜。

examples.en: For the sake of stability, we froze all non-critical changes.
examples.zh: 为了稳定性，我们冻结了所有非关键改动。

situation.zh: 你说为了团队别再熬夜了。
situation.en: For the sake of the team, no more midnight deploys.

examples.en: For the time being, the old API stays alive.
examples.zh: 眼下先让旧接口继续活着。

situation.zh: 你交代临时安排：先这样过渡。
situation.en: You'll report to me for the time being.

examples.en: All in all, the launch went better than anyone expected.
examples.zh: 总的来说，这次上线比所有人预期的都好。

situation.zh: 季度复盘的最后，你想用一句话总结。
situation.en: All in all, a good quarter — two launches, zero major incidents.
